title: Scientology flies Sheehan to Florida to court him as Hubbard's lawyer

tellings.quote: And so uh they flew me down to uh to Florida uh and the big blue cube they've got down there, this big huge blue building.

plain: In the 1970s the Church of Scientology flew a lawyer named Dan Sheehan to Clearwater, Florida, to try to recruit him as a lawyer for its founder, L. Ron Hubbard. Sheehan says this happened to him, and remembers the church's "big blue cube", a huge blue building. He mentions the Guardian's Office, the church's in-house arm that dealt with legal and security matters, as part of the approach.
